source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the neurosecretory role of the hypothalamus (PDF 60-61).

blocks.text: Kai endocrine glands master gland, yaani pituitary, ke qaboo mein hain, magar pituitary khud dimagh ke aik hisse, hypothalamus, ke qaboo mein hai. Hypothalamus mein neurosecretory cells hain jo nerve impulses bhi le jate aur hormones bhi chhorte hain.

items: Posterior pituitary ka qaboo: oxytocin aur ADH hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells banate hain; un ke axons hormones ko posterior pituitary tak le jate hain jahan woh khoon mein chhorne ke liye jama rehte hain.

Anterior pituitary ka qaboo: khoon ki nalyan hypothalamus ko anterior pituitary se jorti hain. Neurosecretory cells aise hormones chhorte hain jo in nalyon se guzarte hain: releasing hormones anterior pituitary se us ke hormones banwate aur chhurwate hain, aur inhibiting hormones use rokte hain.

blocks.caption: Hypothalamus ke hormones aur anterior pituitary par asar

blocks.alt: Baen: neurosecretory cells wala hypothalamus; kuch ke axons danthal (infundibulum) se posterior pituitary mein jate hain, jabke kuch hormones khoon ki nalyon mein chhorte hain jo anterior pituitary tak jati hain; beech mein patla intermediate lobe. Daen: pituitary hormones ki fehrist aur un ke targets ki taraf teer: anterior lobe se GH, ACTH, TSH, LH, FSH aur prolactin, posterior lobe se ADH aur oxytocin, aur intermediate lobe se MSH.
blocks.caption: Hypothalamus aur pituitary (Figure 16.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Pituitary, yaani master gland, khud hypothalamus ke qaboo mein hai. Oxytocin aur ADH hypothalamus ke neurosecretory cells banate aur apne axons ke zariye posterior pituitary tak le jate hain, jo unhein jama kar ke chhorta hai. Hypothalamus ke releasing aur inhibiting hormones khoon ki nalyon se anterior pituitary tak pohanch kar us ke growth hormone, ACTH (adrenal cortex ke liye), TSH (thyroid ke liye), LH aur FSH (gonads ke liye) aur prolactin (mammary glands ke liye) ka ifraz qaboo karte hain. Intermediate lobe MSH banata hai jo melanocytes par asar karta hai.

blocks.explanation: Hypothalamus ke cells jo nerve impulses bhi le jate aur hormones bhi chhorte hain, jaise oxytocin, ADH aur releasing aur inhibiting hormones.

items: Hypothalamus pituitary ko qaboo karta: axons posterior lobe tak (oxytocin, ADH); releasing aur inhibiting hormones khoon ki nalyon se anterior lobe tak.
